# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 19 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 19 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_019_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 19

**19:1** They stood at the entrance to the cave. And behold, a luminous cloud came and overshadowed the cave. The midwife said: "My soul is magnified today, for my eyes have seen wonderful things. Salvation has been born to Israel." At once the cloud withdrew from the cave, and a great light shone inside — so bright that their eyes could not endure it. Little by little the light receded until the infant became visible. And the child went and took the breast of its mother Mary.

**19:2** And the midwife cried out: "This day is a great day for me, for I have seen a new and wondrous sight."

**19:3** The midwife came out of the cave and Salome met her. The midwife said: "Salome, Salome, I have an astounding new thing to tell you. A virgin has given birth — something that nature itself does not permit."

**19:4** Salome replied: "As the Lord my God lives, unless I put my finger in and examine her, I will not believe that a virgin has given birth."

**19:5** The midwife went back into the cave and said to Mary: "Prepare yourself — no small controversy has arisen on your account." And Salome entered and conducted her examination. She cried out: "Woe to me for my iniquity and my unbelief! I have put the living God to the test — and my hand is burning away from me in fire!"

**19:6** And Salome fell to her knees before the Lord, saying: "O God of my fathers, remember me, for I am the offspring of Abraham and Isaac and Jacob. Do not make me an example of punishment before the children of Israel. Restore me to the poor, for you know, Lord, that I have performed my services in your name, and I have received my pay from you."

**19:7** And behold, an angel of the Lord appeared before her, saying: "Salome, Salome, the Lord God has heard your prayer. Bring your hand to the child and lift him up, and you will receive salvation and joy."

**19:8** Salome came near and lifted him up, saying: "I will worship him, for a king has been born to Israel." At once Salome was healed, and she went out from the cave justified, glorifying and praising God. And behold, a voice: "Salome, Salome, do not tell of the marvels you have seen until the child enters Jerusalem."
